selection_reason: Large reported base volume, broad study coverage and concrete applied services converge. This deserves more attention than allocating inputs equally by organism or manufacturer name.
scope_limits: Selected examples are public research proxies. Whole-file structure, integrity and representativeness are not established.

selection_reason: Exome testing, targeted laboratory services and company maize analytical target capture support targeted-library coverage. Reproductive/CNV services independently establish an applied sequencing use, but their purpose does not establish targeted sampling or a file structure different from WGS.
scope_limits: The current inputs cover exome, human circulating-DNA targets and nonhuman population capture. Prenatal/copy-number-specific sampling is not established by application names alone.

selection_reason: Commercial sequencing availability and archive evidence justify a role that ordinary WGS does not describe. Economic importance of breeding alone is insufficient.
scope_limits: Ordinary maize genomic resequencing, quinoa RAD and conifer population capture are documented public research examples. Not all genotyping uses sequencing, and no species quota follows.

public_coverage_category: Reference genomes, pangenomes and non-model assembly
selection_reason: Reference and pangenome uses connect technology to material and research purpose. A public species list or genome economic value cannot prescribe extra files.
scope_limits: Human long-read, mouse, wheat Thatcher, potato short-read, animal and Arabidopsis nuclear-genome roles have selected inputs. Plant HiFi processing is documented; its FASTQ properties remain unpreviewed. Reference-poor non-model assembly and intentional related-species reference testing remain general coverage boundaries. Cyclone whole-file yield and byte equivalence to the associated SRA originals remain unverified.

selection_reason: Large volume and service breadth support transcript sampling independently of genomic DNA. Small-RNA preparation changes the relevant file/reference question.
scope_limits: Bulk and short-RNA libraries have documented source roles and sequence amounts. Whole-file properties remain unverified.

selection_reason: Genomic long reads do not automatically represent transcript concentration, library-associated tags or full-length transcript preparation.
scope_limits: FL-cDNA is supported; direct RNA and PacBio transcript conditions remain unfilled, not inferred from platform alone.

public_coverage_category: Single-cell expression, immune and feature libraries
selection_reason: Archive weight, available services and company research corroborate the tagged-library need without any measured unique quality alphabet.
scope_limits: The Smart-seq2 cell supplies documented transcript-wide sampling. The selected CITE ADT, mRNA and HTO components each contain one complete paired run with two FASTQ files. Actual recovered cells, whole-file pairing and unpreviewed properties remain unknown. Feature/barcode definitions aid interpretation or custom matching, not generic lossless compression. Immune-receptor raw components remain unfilled.

selection_reason: Coordinate/tag structures and documented representations give a clear workload relationship beyond generic bulk RNA.
scope_limits: Two Stereo-seq FASTQs are documented and have 35/100-base inspected prefixes. Full-file acquisition, integrity and pairing remain pending. Masks/coordinates are optional for generic lossless read compression but needed for spatial reconstruction or relevant custom matching. A complete Visium alternative remains unfilled; that does not negate the selected Stereo-seq raw-read role.

public_coverage_category: Chromatin, targeted protein-DNA and proximity libraries
selection_reason: Shared short-read length or alphabet does not collapse different genomic sampling/pair relationships. A mixture role is not pure-species coverage.
scope_limits: Conventional human paired bulk ATAC, rice histone ChIP, human CUT&RUN, yeast Hi-C and Ultima ATAC have distinct documented preparations. Broad OTHER metadata alone does not establish CUT&RUN.

selection_reason: Documented transformation, rather than a species name, motivates the prospective composition/reference contrast.
scope_limits: Selected examples are public research proxies. Whole-file structure, integrity and representativeness are not established.

public_coverage_category: Marker, genomic, viral and forensic target sequencing
selection_reason: Huge run counts justify attention but not proportional input allocation. Pandemic deposits and project concentration must not determine the whole benchmark.
scope_limits: Bacterial 16S, fungal ITS, viral targets, human genomic targets and aquatic eDNA have explicit library units. Exact bacterial/fungal subregions remain unspecified. A conventional forensic-panel condition is not established by these inputs.

public_coverage_category: Microbial isolates and industrial microbial genomes
selection_reason: An industrial sequencing link and reference role justify the need; fermentation economic value or resource deposit alone does not.
scope_limits: Bacterial/yeast genomic inputs are research proxies, not annual industrial throughput.

selection_reason: Multiple genomes, uneven sampling and incomplete reference coverage are meaningful prospective conditions; a marker file is not a generic replacement.
scope_limits: Gut, soil and food shotgun DNA, a long-read mock community and fermentation-community RNA supply distinct mixture conditions. Mixture composition and reference sets remain unverified.

selection_reason: Actual sequencing use justifies coverage even without a clean archive label or market denominator; method uncertainty prevents presumed file equivalence, not recognition of the use.
scope_limits: The selected Lugano ITD20-A/VENE aquatic marker run serves the documented sample-associated eDNA role. Exact pre-upload stages remain qualified; it is not every environmental monitoring assay or an entire flow-cell.

selection_reason: Processed multi-eukaryotic food mixtures are a real applied use that neither a pure crop genome nor a gut microbiome automatically represents.
scope_limits: Honey shotgun DNA supplies the selected food-mixture input. Ingredient composition and an exact mixture-reference set remain unverified; a targeted processed-food authentication configuration is not specified.

public_coverage_category: Biopharma genomic characterization and sequence quality control
selection_reason: Direct NGS/WGS service links establish an industrial data use beyond generic pharma research. Library uncertainty does not erase that confirmed use, but prevents an invented assay specification.
scope_limits: The complete paired CHO genomic run is a public production-cell reference-assembly research input. It does not specify a manufacturing-testing assay; exact cell-line/construct/reference match remains unknown.
